home.f1Desc: Enjoy 2 private manasik sessions at no additional cost as a companion to group manasik, preparing your Umrah worship optimally before departure.
home.f2Title: Luggage Delivered Directly to Hotel Room

home.f3Desc: Our selected hotels are in premium locations, approximately 5–7 minutes walk to Masjid al-Haram in Makkah and Al-Masjid an-Nabawi in Madinah.
home.f4Title: Free Tour Plus to Taif and Badar
home.f4Desc: In addition to performing Umrah, pilgrims will have the opportunity to join religious tours to Taif and Jabal Nur.
home.f5Desc: Get the opportunity to perform Umrah 3 times in one trip! Fulfill your sincere intention to dedicate the rewards of Umrah for your beloved parents and family.
home.f6Desc: Our Mutawwif are more than just worship guides; they are verified companions with social sensitivity, ensuring your pilgrimage is well-guided and comfortable.

panduan.heroDesc: Step-by-step guidance to perfect your holy pilgrimage in the Holy Land according to the Sunnah of Prophet Muhammad SAW.
panduan.rukunDesc: A series of rituals that must be performed sequentially and cannot be replaced by a penalty (Dam). If omitted, the Umrah is invalid.
panduan.step1Desc: Wearing Ihram garments and making the intention to perform Umrah at the Miqat boundary.
panduan.step2Desc: Circumambulating the Kaaba 7 times counterclockwise, starting and ending at Hajar al-Aswad.
panduan.step3Desc: Walking/brisk walking 7 times between Safa and Marwah hills, starting at Safa and ending at Marwah.
panduan.step4Desc: Shaving or trimming hair (at least 3 strands) signaling the completion of the Umrah rituals.
panduan.wajibDesc: Obligations in Umrah that must be performed. If omitted due to a valid excuse or intentionally, the Umrah remains valid but the pilgrim must pay a penalty (Dam):

wajibList.title: Niat (Intention) for Ihram from Miqat
wajibList.desc: Making the sacred intention for Umrah at designated geographical boundaries (such as Bir Ali/Dzulkulaifah for Madinah travelers, or Yalamlam for Yemen/Indonesia travelers).

wajibList.title: Refraining from Ihram Prohibitions
wajibList.desc: Avoiding forbidden actions while in the state of Ihram until Tahallul is completed.

panduan.laranganDesc: Prohibited actions for pilgrims who have entered the state of Ihram and pronounced the intention until Tahallul:
laranganList: Hunting wild animals in the holy land
panduan.bookDesc: To facilitate your preparation and devotion, we provide interactive pocket guidebooks and prayers for direct reading and download.
panduan.book1Desc: Detailed practical guide on Umrah rituals, specific prayers during travel, and worship tips from expert guides.
panduan.book2Desc: Comprehensive collection of essential prayers and prophetic dhikr from Ihram, Tawaf, Sa'i, to entering Masjidil Haram & Nabawi.
panduan.consultDesc: Our spiritual guidance team and Customer Service are ready to answer all your questions and accompany your pilgrimage preparation.
